title: Oral Pathology and Oral Medicine I: Main Exam, 10 November 2025
unitTitle: Oral Pathology and Oral Medicine I
instructions: ATTEMPT ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY TWO IN SECTION B

items.text: Explain the process of describing a pathological condition.
Explain the etiology of developmental abnormalities of the face and oral cavity.
Differentiate between hyperplasia and hypertrophy of oral cavity tissues.
Outline the results from failure of fusion of facial processes.
Discuss the classification and clinical significance of oral ulcers.
Explain the four (4) types and clinical features of periodontal diseases.
Explain the general factors affecting structural defects of teeth.
